written_before: any model of this run was trained, exported or scored
question: does adding Cloudflare Clef silver labels (16-shot kNN teacher, scripts/clef_teacher.py) on 1,757 new hand-written notes aimed at known weak spots improve encoder 1 (type + target, word snap on) + the unchanged rule value parser over the released run 4 (gidi-finance-v3), without regressing the frozen test, probe-v1 and human-value-01?

teacher.probe_numbers: validation 0.936 type / 0.955 target; human-value-02 0.953 type / 0.874 target / 0.832 type+target (v3 student 0.921 / 0.853)
teacher.note: labels are model labels, never human labels; silver data is train-only and lives apart from labels.jsonl / corpus/reviewed

silver_pool: datasets/annotation-v3/distill-clef-01 (manifest.json): 1,757 notes that passed the leakage gate, labelled once, filters fixed now: silver-A = type max prob >= 0.6 and target prob >= 0.6 (952 notes); silver-B = type max prob >= 0.5 and target prob >= 0.4 (1,344 notes)

arms.run5_control: training-v5 as trained in annotation-v3-retrain-v5 (no new training; reuse its stored results)
arms.A: training-v5 train + silver-A (the pre-declared release candidate arm)

release_candidate.rule: arm A, seed 1, word snap on. Fixed now: not chosen among arms or seeds by any held-out score; no seed is re-run, dropped or swapped after scoring.

recipe: unchanged from retrain-v5 (supervised student-4x768, BamiBERT layers 2/5/8/11, pos32, vocab B-rank-8000, FFN combined-K2048, 40 epochs, batch 8, encoder lr 5e-5, head lr 1e-3, warmup 0.1, wd 0.01, dropout 0.1, grad-clip 1.0, MPS, last epoch, --retokenize); all training data records are weighted equally, no soft labels
value: unchanged rule parser gidi.value_parser.parse_value for every system
held_out_scored_in_this_run: human-value-02 (190 complete, LLM labels; already used for the v3 release decision, so it is a reused test set)
controls: run 4 seed 1 + snap = shipped gidi-finance-v3 (stored results)
success_criterion: arm A seed 1 end-to-end exact (type + target + value) on human-value-02 >= 0.8105 (run 4 seed 1 scores 0.7895; +4 notes of 190 or better), AND no regression larger than 0.02 against run 4 seed 1 on each of: frozen test type macro-F1, frozen test target exact, probe-v1 type macro-F1, human-value-01 end-to-end exact. Also report each seed and the three-seed mean for arms A and B; nothing is selected by them.
no_tuning: no threshold, prompt, data-selection or snap rule is changed after seeing held-out numbers. If the criterion fails the result is reported as a failure, and the next step is a user decision.
leakage: builder must raise (write nothing) if any silver or train note matches the frozen test, probe-v1, human-value-01 or human-value-02 by id, verbatim text or NFC-lowercase text, or is a near duplicate under the rules already used by scripts/build_annotation_v3_training_v5.py
